summary: Tested Winning Angle Tracker end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass — auth required (401 without token), 404 for bad client_id, full CRUD (create with default status 'reused' + auto-filled client_name/industry, list by client_id, PUT status cycle testing/reused/won, invalid status ignored, DELETE removes), and POST /api/ads/create still returns valid campaign JSON after an angle is tracked (proven-angles injection does not break generation, ~10-20s Claude call). Frontend E2E: logged in as admin, opened ABC HVAC client, switched to Ad Intel tab (tab-intel), clicked track-angle-btn on a 'how we win' item → winning-angles panel rendered with the new angle. Status pill cycled reused → won → testing on successive clicks. Delete removed the angle from the panel.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~1102 lines — recommend splitting into routers (ads, angles, creatives, clients, auth) for maintainability.
get_proven_angles builds q={'$or': []} and appends; harmless but returns early when both filters missing — fine but could be simplified.
Frontend removeAngle has no error toast (silent failure if API errors); minor UX polish.
cycleAngle updates optimistically only after refetch — small latency between click and pill change is acceptable but could be optimistic for snappier UX.
seed_data_creation: Test created and deleted transient TEST_ANGLE_* angles under ABC HVAC via pytest; frontend E2E created and then deleted one angle via UI. No lingering data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Winning Angle Tracker fully validated (backend CRUD + AI context injection + UI track/cycle/delete). No fixes needed.
